sql: SELECT country, COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers GROUP BY country
SELECT p.productName FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE p.productLine = 'Classic Cars' AND p.productScale = '1:18' ORDER BY od.quantityOrdered DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE creditLimit <= 100000) AS cnt, c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE c.creditLimit <= 100000 AND strftime('%Y', p.paymentDate) = '2004' GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName, SUM(p.amount) FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN payments p ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.city = 'Tokyo' AND e.reportsTo = 1056 GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName ORDER BY MAX(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails od JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach > 4000 AND o.status = 'Cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails od JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE strftime('%Y', o.orderDate) = '2003' AND od.quantityOrdered < 30
SELECT COUNT(od.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.MSRP - p.buyPrice > 100
SELECT DISTINCT c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE p.amount > 50000
SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'USA'
SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.creditLimit = 0 AND strftime('%Y', p.paymentDate) = '2003'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customerNumber FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'France' AND o.status = 'Shipped' GROUP BY c.customerNumber HAVING COUNT(o.orderNumber) = 2)
SELECT e.email FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE o.city = 'Sydney' AND e.jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%'
SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Australia' AND creditLimit < 220000
SELECT customerNumber FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT e.email, e.employeeNumber FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE o.country = 'USA' AND o.state = 'CA'
SELECT MAX(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) - AVG(od.priceEach) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.productLine = 'Planes'

SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName, e2.firstName, e2.lastName FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN employees e1 ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e1.employeeNumber JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber ORDER BY p.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pr.productName, od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN customers c ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN orders r ON r.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = r.orderNumber JOIN products pr ON pr.productCode = od.productCode WHERE o.city = 'Boston' AND e.jobTitle = 'Sales Rep' ORDER BY od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(od.priceEach - p.buyPrice) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'USA' AND o.orderDate BETWEEN '2003-01-06' AND '2005-05-09'
